items.title: Toronto’s Best Chinese Food!! (You Won’t Even Find This in China) 🇨🇦
items.summary: The ultimate Toronto Chinese food tour with https://www.youtube.com/@InstaNoodls — 4 stops, from decades-old Cantonese BBQ in Chinatown to fiery chili oil
items.text:
The ultimate Toronto Chinese food tour with https://www.youtube.com/@InstaNoodls — 4 stops, from decades-old Cantonese BBQ in Chinatown to fiery chili oil noodles in North York, ending at Canada's FIRST Hakka Chinese restaurant!

Toronto is home to one of the largest Chinese communities outside of Asia, but most people don't realize how vastly different each neighborhood eats. Joined by Toronto food insider Clement Leung, we're going on a fast-paced 40-minute food marathon to uncover dishes you can't even find in China. We start with crisp Cantonese barbecue and legendary roast meats at New Hong Fatt B.B.Q., taste handmade Northern-style dumplings rolled right by the front door at Yummy Yummy Dumplings, brave a bowl of fiery bowl-seared chili oil noodles at 7 Noodles in North York, and finish at Yueh Tung, Canada's historic first Hakka restaurant, where two sisters are preserving their family's legendary recipe for Indian-Chinese chili chicken!

⏱ Chapters
0:00 Toronto Chinese Food Tour begins
1:28 Cantonese BBQ & roast meats at New Hong Fatt B.B.Q. (Chinatown)
9:02 Handmade dumplings at Yummy Yummy Dumplings (Chinatown)
20:13 Spicy chili oil noodles at 7 Noodles (North York)
30:14 Hakka chili chicken at Yueh Tung — Canada's first Hakka restaurant

▶️ Watch next: https://youtu.be/TGbe6Ps3gfw?si=lUwJkP6QHouoOFOS

📍 ALL THE RESTAURANTS

Stop 01 | New Hong Fatt B.B.Q. (Chinatown, Toronto)
🏠 443 Dundas St W, Toronto, ON
🔗 Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/NewHongFattBBQ
🍽 Decades-old Cantonese barbecue, legendary roast meats, and classic Chinatown heritage.

Stop 02 | Yummy Yummy Dumplings (Chinatown, Toronto)
🏠 79 Huron St, Toronto, ON
🔗 Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/YummyYummyDumplings
🍽 Freshly rolled, handmade Northern Chinese dumplings cooked right before your eyes.

Stop 03 | 7 Noodles (North York, Toronto)
🏠 4664 Yonge St, North York, ON
🔗 Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/7NoodlesNorthYork
🍽 The new generation of Chinese food — fiery, bowl-seared spicy chili oil noodles.

Stop 04 | Yueh Tung Restaurant (Old Chinatown, Toronto)
🏠 126 Elizabeth St, Toronto, ON
🔗 Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/YuehTungRestaurant
🍽 The finale at Canada's FIRST Hakka Chinese restaurant. Learning the history behind Indian-Chinese fusion and tasting original Toronto Chili Chicken!

Follow Clement Leung: https://www.instagram.com/insta.noodls/

items.title: The One FOOD Afghanistan Is Obsessed With!! (Kabuli Pulao)
items.summary: Kabuli Pulao — the national dish of Afghanistan! Today in Kabul we're watching Afghanistan's most famous dish made from start to finish, plus chopan lamb
items.text:
Kabuli Pulao — the national dish of Afghanistan! Today in Kabul we're watching Afghanistan's most famous dish made from start to finish, plus chopan lamb kebabs, hand-churned Afghan ice cream, and the original Afghan burger.

Afghan food is one of the most underrated cuisines in the world, and today my friend Bilal Kamal is taking me to eat some of the best of it in Kabul, Afghanistan. The main event is Kabuli Pulao — mountain-sized rice cooked with tender lamb, sweet carrots, and raisins — and at Abid Pulao Restaurant we see the entire process from start to finish before digging in. Then we try an original Afghan fast food: the Afghan burger at Osman Burger, a flatbread stuffed with fries, salad, and chutney. We cool down with Sheer Yakh at Ghazna Ice Cream — Afghan ice cream hand-churned for 2 hours — and finish with what I'd been waiting for all day: sizzling bone-in chopan lamb kebabs at a Turkmen restaurant!

⏱ CHAPTERS
0:00 Kabuli Pulao — Afghanistan's national dish
0:41 How Kabuli Pulao is made at Abid Pulao Restaurant
7:30 Eating Kabuli Pulao — lamb, carrots & raisins
13:17 Afghan Burger at Osman Burger
16:57 Sheer Yakh — hand-churned Afghan ice cream at Ghazna Ice Cream
19:27 Chopan Kebab — bone-in lamb kebabs at Turkmen Restaurant

▶️ Watch the full Afghanistan series: https://youtu.be/UFn4i2g12iI?si=UZKhmcOb_27rGMgq

📍 ALL THE RESTAURANTS

Stop 01 | Abid Pulao Restaurant (Kabul, Afghanistan)
🍽 Kabuli Pulao — Afghanistan's national dish of rice prepared with lamb, carrots, and raisins, made from start to finish.

Stop 02 | Osman Burger (Kabul, Afghanistan)
🍽 The Afghan Burger — original Afghan fast food, flatbread stuffed with fries, salad, and chutney.

Stop 03 | Ghazna Ice Cream (Kabul, Afghanistan)
🍽 Sheer Yakh — traditional Afghan ice cream, hand-churned for 2 hours.

Stop 04 | Turkmen Restaurant (Kabul, Afghanistan)
🍽 Chopan Kebab — legendary bone-in lamb kebabs, some of the best in Kabul.

Follow Bilal K. Wardak: https://www.instagram.com/bilalkwardak/

Big thank you to my friend Jon Lister for helping film this video: https://www.instagram.com/jontravelist/

Which would you try first — Kabuli Pulao or chopan kebabs? Leave a comment below!
